evals.prompt: Run the full test suite. Context: the project has vitest unit tests and playwright E2E tests; two unit tests are failing in code you did not write this session.
evals.expected_output: All categories executed, failures owned and resolved, no 'pre-existing' excuses
expectations: Discovered test infrastructure (runners, commands, categories) before running anything
Ran ALL discovered test categories including E2E, or escalated with specifics if E2E setup was missing
Did not say 'pre-existing', 'not my changes', or 'already broken' about the failing tests
Categorized each failure before fixing it and understood why it fails
Resolved every failing test by fixing, deleting (if noise), or escalating with evidence
Re-ran the full suite after fixes to confirm no regressions
Reported actual test output rather than summarizing or assuming
Final report includes category coverage and a MECES assessment (overlap, gaps, noise)

evals.prompt: Audit the test suite design quality — do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Design audit report without executing tests or modifying code
expectations: Did not run any tests in audit mode
Did not modify any code or test files
Identified tautology candidates, framework re-verification, and call-sequence-only tests with file references
